chunk_title: Physical Presence, Body Language & Vocal Mechanics Across All 6 Archetypes

sections.title: Non-Verbal Cues, Eye Contact & Spatial Ownership
bullets: The Dolphin relies on vulnerable and welcoming non-verbal signals, featuring frequent head tilts to indicate active interest, spontaneous Duchenne smiles, and visible open palms to communicate honesty and non-threatening openness [DP-8].

The Fox utilizes agile, kinetic, and fluid body language, maintaining an observant and alert posture, subtle micro-expressions, and lateral eye contact that scans the room for situational leverage [DP-12].

The Lion commands physical space through radical stillness, expansive open posture, and unblinking eye contact, demonstrating high status by drastically reducing physical pacing and eliminating extraneous fidgeting [DP-9].

The Owl displays an economic, restrained physical presence with minimal non-verbal leakage, neutral baseline facial composure, and laser-focused gaze that processes information without emotional volatility [DP-10].

The Peacock occupies physical space dramatically through large sweeping gestures, expansive theatrical postures, vibrant animated facial expressions, and an unapologetic center-stage physical orientation [DP-11].

The Bear / Wolf projects an immovable grounded presence characterized by relaxed, dropped shoulders, rooted stance, deep diaphragmatic breathing, and a watchful gaze that radiates calm containment during chaos [DP-13].

data_points.data_point: Dolphins utilize head tilts, genuine smiling, and open palms as nonverbal cues to establish warmth, trust, and psychological safety
data_points.quoted_text: These nonverbal cues—head tilt, smiling, and open palms—are powerful, universally recognized signals that build warmth, rapport, and charisma by subconsciously communicating that you are approachable, honest, and non-threatening.
data_points.verification_query: "head tilt" "smiling" "open palms" warmth charisma nonverbal cues
data_points.grep_result: head tilt, smiling, and open palms are powerful, universally recognized signals that build warmth, rapport, and charisma

data_points.data_point: Lions employ downward inflections to signal certainty and absolute stillness to establish unthreatened executive status
data_points.quoted_text: By dropping the pitch at the end of a sentence, a speaker communicates competence and reduces the perception of needing approval... reducing physical pace—minimizing fidgeting, pacing, or rapid gestures—signals that a person is 'resourced' and not under threat.
data_points.grep_result: dropping the pitch at the end of a sentence communicates competence and reduces the perception of needing approval... stillness signals that a person is resourced and not under threat

data_points.data_point: Owls leverage intentional pauses, deliberate stillness, and low-variance precision to command respect through restraint
data_points.quoted_text: the use of intentional pauses (silence), stillness, and downward inflection allows a leader to influence the room's energy without appearing to 'try' too hard... replace 'um' or 'uh' with a deliberate pause
data_points.grep_result: the use of intentional pauses (silence), stillness, and downward inflection allows a leader to influence the room's energy without appearing to try too hard

data_points.data_point: Peacocks exhibit dramatic sweeping gestures, expressive body language, and a strong colorful voice that commands the room
data_points.quoted_text: Peacocks are naturally expressive and animated... strong and colourful voice and are often described as talkative... dramatic and sweeping gestures. Their energy is infectious
data_points.grep_result: Peacocks are naturally expressive and animated... strong and colourful voice... dramatic and sweeping gestures. Their energy is infectious

data_points.data_point: Foxes navigate social spaces with fluid, observant body language and clever conversational timing rather than physical dominance
data_points.quoted_text: The fox archetype often manifests as movements that are deliberate, agile, and fluid... body language is typically observant and cautious rather than dominant... observational humor: a tendency toward satire or clever wit
data_points.verification_query: "Fox personality" OR "fox archetype" "body language" OR "vocal" OR "wit" "adaptability"
data_points.grep_result: movements that are deliberate, agile, and fluid... observant and cautious rather than dominant or aggressive... observational humor and clever wit

data_points.data_point: Bear and Wolf archetypes anchor rooms through grounded physical calm, slow breathing, and acting as emotional containers
data_points.quoted_text: Bear personalities possess a quiet, unassuming authority... their steady nature makes others feel safe and anchored during chaotic times... resist the urge to react impulsively... unshakeable calm
data_points.grep_result: quiet, unassuming authority... makes others feel safe and anchored during chaotic times... unshakeable calm acting as a stabilizing force
